en.text:
Every point of damage taken while Guarding grants Class Ability Energy:
• #e${1.5+#d}% when Melee Damage is Blocked
• #e${1+#f}% when non-Melee Damage is Blocked
• #e${0.5+#g}% when damage isn't Blocked (getting hit from behind)

#ChunkEnergyScalars

enhanced (
var d = 0.055
var f = 0.5
var g = 0.125
#e Increases Class Ability Energy gains by an additive 0.055%, 0.5%, and 0.125% in that order.
)
